title: A Network Approach to Affect Regulation Dynamics and Personality Trait-Induced Variations: Extraversion and Neuroticism Moderate Reciprocal Influences between Affect and Affect Regulation Strategies
limitations: - Sample size may be small for generalizability; - Did not assess affectively salient events; - Analysis strategies (e.g., not including random slopes) may have overstated significance.
notes: The paper is registered on OSF with pre-registered hypotheses and materials. The code and data are openly available on OSF.
